bio.jane/contract.noScientificClaim: Lists the scaffolds we have sourced with their citations; it computes nothing.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which sgRNA scaffolds has this workbench sourced, for which nucleases, from which publication?

description: Every sgRNA scaffold this workbench has sourced, with the nucleases each covers and the publication it comes from. A scaffold not listed here is one we do not have — the list is what we ship, not what exists.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

name: list_sgrna_scaffolds

scaffolds.description: each scaffold: id, name, sequence, length, which side of the spacer it sits, the nucleases it covers, its citation and accessions
